plain: The right of the first-born, usually the eldest son, to inherit

webster.text: The state of being born first of the same parents; seniority by birth among children.

example.quote: Our manners, our laws, the abolition of entails and of primogeniture, the whole genius of the people, are opposed to it.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 7, 1787
